-- True when the path, after resolving "." and "..", stays inside its root.
-- Absolute paths, empty names, and any path that climbs above the root are rejected.
stays_inside(path: str) -> bool =
  ex stays_inside("a.txt") == True
  ex stays_inside("sub/../a.txt") == True
  ex stays_inside("..") == False
  ex stays_inside("sub/../../x") == False
  ex stays_inside("/etc/passwd") == False
  ex stays_inside("") == False
  if path.split("\\").len() > 1
    return False
  let parts = path.split("/")
  var depth = 0
  var first = True
  for p in parts
    if first
      first = False
      if p == ""
        return False
    if p == "" or p == "."
      continue
    if p == ".."
      depth -= 1
      if depth < 0
        return False
    else
      depth += 1
  depth > 0

-- Reads notes/<path> through an fs capability confined to "notes".
-- Returns "" when the path leaves notes or the file is missing or unreadable.
read_public(path: str) -> str uses fs =
  post stays_inside(path) or out == ""
  ex read_public("../x") == ""
  ex read_public("sub/../../x") == ""
  ex read_public("/etc/passwd") == ""
  if not stays_inside(path)
    return ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    return fs.read(path) else ""
